SELECT SEQ_GROUP_ROOM_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO GROUP_CHAT_ROOM (GROUP_ROOM_NO, COMPANION_NO, ROOM_NAME) VALUES (#{groupRoomNo}, #{companionNo}, #{roomName})
mapper.select: SELECT GROUP_ROOM_NO FROM GROUP_CHAT_ROOM WHERE COMPANION_NO = #{companionNo} FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GROUP_CHAT_MEMBER (GROUP_MEMBER_ID, GROUP_ROOM_NO, MEMBER_NO) VALUES (SEQ_GROUP_MEMBER_ID.NEXTVAL, #{groupRoomNo}, #{memberNo})
mapper.select: WITH MY_ROOMS AS ( SELECT r.GROUP_ROOM_NO, r.COMPANION_NO, r.ROOM_NAME, r.CREATED_AT, lm.LAST_MESSAGE, lm.LAST_SEND_TIME, lm.LAST_MSG_NO, NVL(rd.LAST_READ_MSG, 0) AS LAST_READ_MSG FROM GROUP_CHAT_ROOM r JOIN GROUP_CHAT_MEMBER my ON my.GROUP_ROOM_NO = r.GROUP_ROOM_NO AND my.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT GROUP_ROOM_NO, MAX(GROUP_MSG_NO) AS LAST_MSG_NO, MAX(MSG_CONTENT) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY GROUP_MSG_NO) AS LAST_MESSAGE, TO_CHAR(MAX(SEND_TIME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY GROUP_MSG_NO), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS LAST_SEND_TIME FROM GROUP_MESSAGE GROUP BY GROUP_ROOM_NO ) lm ON lm.GROUP_ROOM_NO = r.GROUP_ROOM_NO LEFT JOIN GROUP_MSG_READ rd ON rd.GROUP_ROOM_NO = r.GROUP_ROOM_NO AND rd.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ), MEMBER_COUNT AS ( SELECT GROUP_ROOM_NO, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM GROUP_CHAT_MEMBER GROUP BY GROUP_ROOM_NO ), UNREAD AS ( SELECT mr.GROUP_ROOM_NO, COUNT(*) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM MY_ROOMS mr JOIN GROUP_MESSAGE gm ON gm.GROUP_ROOM_NO = mr.GROUP_ROOM_NO AND gm.GROUP_MSG_NO > mr.LAST_READ_MSG GROUP BY mr.GROUP_ROOM_NO ) SELECT mr.GROUP_ROOM_NO, mr.COMPANION_NO, mr.ROOM_NAME, mr.LAST_MESSAGE, mr.LAST_SEND_TIME, NVL(u.UNREAD_COUNT, 0) AS UNREAD_COUNT, mc.CNT AS MEMBER_COUNT, m.MEMBER_NO, m.NICKNAME, m.PROFILE_IMAGE FROM MY_ROOMS mr JOIN MEMBER_COUNT mc ON mc.GROUP_ROOM_NO = mr.GROUP_ROOM_NO LEFT JOIN UNREAD u ON u.GROUP_ROOM_NO = mr.GROUP_ROOM_NO JOIN GROUP_CHAT_MEMBER gcm ON gcm.GROUP_ROOM_NO = mr.GROUP_ROOM_NO JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_NO = gcm.MEMBER_NO ORDER BY mr.LAST_MSG_NO DESC NULLS LAST, mr.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT m.MEMBER_NO, m.NICKNAME, m.PROFILE_IMAGE FROM GROUP_CHAT_MEMBER gcm JOIN MEMBER m ON gcm.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO WHERE gcm.GROUP_ROOM_NO = #{groupRoomNo} ORDER BY gcm.JOINED_AT ASC

SELECT SEQ_GROUP_MSG_NO.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO GROUP_MESSAGE (GROUP_MSG_NO, GROUP_ROOM_NO, SENDER_NO, MSG_CONTENT) VALUES (#{groupMsgNo}, #{groupRoomNo}, #{senderNo}, #{msgContent})
mapper.update: MERGE INTO GROUP_MSG_READ dst USING (SELECT #{groupRoomNo} AS GROUP_ROOM_NO, #{memberNo} AS MEMBER_NO, CASE WHEN #{lastReadMsg} = 0 THEN NVL((SELECT MAX(GROUP_MSG_NO) FROM GROUP_MESSAGE WHERE GROUP_ROOM_NO = #{groupRoomNo}), 0) ELSE #{lastReadMsg} END AS LAST_READ_MSG FROM DUAL) src ON (dst.GROUP_ROOM_NO = src.GROUP_ROOM_NO AND dst.MEMBER_NO = src.MEMBER_NO) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET dst.LAST_READ_MSG = src.LAST_READ_MSG WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (READ_ID, GROUP_ROOM_NO, MEMBER_NO, LAST_READ_MSG) VALUES (SEQ_GROUP_READ_ID.NEXTVAL, src.GROUP_ROOM_NO, src.MEMBER_NO, src.LAST_READ_MSG)
